description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for database connection, SQL query generation using OpenAI, and data retrieval and presentation related to a school database.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt string for SQL query creation based on user question and template.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI's chat API to generate SQL queries or answers.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed between ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates token-based cost for query and answer processing.
